outcome: Scaffolding a new project copies the template directory using the platform's own recursive copy rather than a hand-rolled one.

acceptance_criteria.text: A template directory is copied to the target, including nested directories.

expected_verification.assertion: scaffolding a template produces the same file tree at the destination

acceptance_criteria.text: The copy behaves the same on every supported platform and Node version, including for paths outside ASCII.

expected_verification.assertion: a template containing a non-ASCII filename scaffolds correctly on Windows

data_impact: Writes a project directory on the user's machine.
security_impact: None directly. A copy that writes outside the intended destination is a path-handling fault.
rollback: git revert restores the hand-rolled copy.
